summary: I establish topical authority for websites with semantic SEO, backed by technical, local, on-page and off-page SEO. I increase organic traffic, leads and rankings with data-driven strategy and well-planned content.

roles.title: SEO Team Lead
bullets: Led the SEO team and set data-driven strategy for local service and e-commerce projects.
Planned project workflows and delivered SEO initiatives on schedule.
Mentored team members and partnered with developers and content teams on implementation.
Owned SEO projects end to end, from strategy and execution to performance analysis.

roles.title: SEO Specialist
bullets: Developed and executed technical, on-page and local SEO strategies to grow organic traffic.
Optimized e-commerce category and product pages and improved site information architecture.
Strengthened topical authority with content strategy and semantic optimization.

roles.title: SEO Executive
bullets: Executed keyword research, on-page optimization and technical SEO fixes.
Managed Google Business Profiles and local SEO for service businesses.
Tracked rankings and reported performance to stakeholders.

roles.title: SEO Intern
bullets: Learned core SEO fundamentals and supported on-page and technical tasks.
Supported keyword research, SEO audits and content optimization.

roles.title: Data Entry, GStacking & Link Building
bullets: Performed Google stacking and off-page link building.
Created citations and managed data entry for local SEO campaigns.

knowledge.title: Entity-focused semantic SEO
knowledge.text: I apply an entity-first, holistic approach that positions each website as an authority in its niche. Koray Tugberk Gubur's topical authority methodology shapes this approach.

knowledge.title: Content and topical authority
knowledge.text: I design topical maps and content architectures that cover a niche in depth. Structured briefs pair entity-based optimization with search intent and semantic relevance.

knowledge.title: SEO patents and whitepapers
knowledge.text: I study Google's patents and whitepapers on ranking signals and semantic search. I turn the findings into practical SEO strategy.

knowledge.title: Programmatic SEO, GEO and AI search
knowledge.text: I launch programmatic SEO systems for large keyword sets. I structure content and entities so brands appear in AI answers on ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity and Google's AI Overviews.

knowledge.title: SEO hypothesis testing
knowledge.text: I test SEO ideas with experiments on AI-generated content, exact match domains and technical variables. The results show which changes move rankings.

knowledge.title: Reddit SEO
knowledge.text: I earn topical relevance, referral traffic and visibility in Google and AI search through Reddit participation, discussion-led content and brand mentions.
